components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized into E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped,
            an explicit leading '+' and country code are kept, otherwise country
            code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the
            national digits. The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the '+'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 40
          example: '6085551023'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The e-mail address of the pet owner. Optional, but when present it
            must be a syntactically valid address. The value is stored and
            returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's
            current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, permits creating this owner even though another owner
            already has the same last name and address (they knowingly share a
            household). Write-only; it is never stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true

## What I implemented

The spec: when more than 80 owners have already been created today, the owner response includes `bulkSignupWarning: true`; otherwise `false`.

I followed the same "derive-at-creation, persist, read back" pattern the codebase already uses for `namesakeCount`, `customerCode`, and `householdId`:

1. **`Owner` model** — added a persisted `Boolean bulkSignupWarning` field (`bulk_signup_warning` column) with getter/setter.

2. **`ClinicServiceImpl.createOwner`** — after the existing quota/derivation steps, sets the flag via a new `exceedsBulkSignupThreshold(owner)`. It reuses the exact accumulation path as the daily-limit rule (`countOwnersRegisteredOn(day)`, keyed on the owner's `registrationDate` which the controller defaults to today), and returns `true` when that count is `> 80`. Since the count is taken before persisting, it reflects owners already created that day.

3. **`openapi.yml`** — added the read-only `bulkSignupWarning` boolean to the `Owner` schema so the generated `OwnerDto` carries it.

4. **`OwnerMapper`** — added a mapping expression that coerces a `null` stored value to `false`, guaranteeing the field is always present (satisfying "otherwise false" even for pre-existing/seed owners).

5. **Schema DDL** — added the `bulk_signup_warning BOOLEAN` column to all four schemas (hsqldb — used by tests — plus h2, mysql, postgres).

## Verification

- `AcceptanceTest.coreNoBulkWarningUnderThreshold` passes: a fresh create returns `$.bulkSignupWarning == false`.
- Full `./mvnw test` → **BUILD SUCCESS**, `Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0`.

The `>80` branch shares the daily-limit counting path, so it accumulates identically once more than 80 owners exist for the day.

The spec: when more than 80 owners have already been created today, the owner response includes `bulkSignupWarning: true`; otherwise `false`.

I followed the same "derive-at-creation, persist, read back" pattern the codebase already uses for `namesakeCount`, `customerCode`, and `householdId`:

1. **`Owner` model** — added a persisted `Boolean bulkSignupWarning` field (`bulk_signup_warning` column) with getter/setter.

2. **`ClinicServiceImpl.createOwner`** — after the existing quota/derivation steps, sets the flag via a new `exceedsBulkSignupThreshold(owner)`. It reuses the exact accumulation path as the daily-limit rule (`countOwnersRegisteredOn(day)`, keyed on the owner's `registrationDate` which the controller defaults to today), and returns `true` when that count is `> 80`. Since the count is taken before persisting, it reflects owners already created that day.

3. **`openapi.yml`** — added the read-only `bulkSignupWarning` boolean to the `Owner` schema so the generated `OwnerDto` carries it.

4. **`OwnerMapper`** — added a mapping expression that coerces a `null` stored value to `false`, guaranteeing the field is always present (satisfying "otherwise false" even for pre-existing/seed owners).

5. **Schema DDL** — added the `bulk_signup_warning BOOLEAN` column to all four schemas (hsqldb — used by tests — plus h2, mysql, postgres).
